triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece || piece.currentHp <= 0) return false; if (!ctx.piece || ctx.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return false; return !!(piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'chidori-immobile'; })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return { success: false }; var tag = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'chidori-immobile'; }); if (!tag) { self.expire(); return { success: false }; } return { success: true, blocked: true, message: piece.name + '被千鸟贯穿，本回合无法移动' }; }
